skill.name: set-up-magento-chatgpt-ads-poas-bidding
skill.description: Use Product Metrics to connect Magento order values to ChatGPT Ads through the OpenAI Conversions API. Verify profit or revenue events and plan a bidding target. A developer installs the Magento module, and the advertiser selects the campaign conversion.
skill.summary: Set up and verify profit-based bidding for Magento in ChatGPT Ads.
skill.author: product-metrics

security_audit.summary: Most static alerts matched documentation, scoped setup checks, or ordinary conversion guidance. Confirmed risks involve third-party tool and package trust, broad live-order access, and unsafe handling of credentials and browser handoffs. The setup also needs clearer disclosure before enabling tracking; no evidence of auditor-directed prompt injection or deliberate credential theft was found.

remediation.issue: The agent may request a raw Conversions API key despite the no-chat guidance.
remediation.suggestion: Enter the key only in the authenticated Product Metrics form or through a secret input that excludes chat, command arguments, and tool traces.

remediation.issue: Order checks can read recent live transactions rather than a known test order.
remediation.suggestion: Require the correct store view and a test-order identifier. Report only delivery status and the profit value needed for verification.

remediation.issue: Installation relies on repository content that the skill does not verify.
remediation.suggestion: Pin the installer and skill revision. Verify the Magento package source and integrity, review Composer changes, and test the module in staging before deployment.

remediation.issue: The remote connector exposes a generic execution interface.
remediation.suggestion: Allow only the setup and test-order operations needed. Confirm the account, property, and requested change before a write.

remediation.issue: Setup responses can supply unvalidated browser URLs.
remediation.suggestion: Accept only HTTPS URLs on explicitly approved setup hosts. Reject unexpected destinations and direct users to the authenticated app instead.

remediation.issue: Enabling delivery for profit bidding also enables broader event and customer-data sharing.
remediation.suggestion: Show the destination, event types, and customer fields before enabling delivery. Confirm approval and test that each consent rule blocks the expected fields or events.

semantic_findings.title: Raw API Key May Enter Agent Traces
semantic_findings.description: The skill allows agents to request API credentials and pass them directly to commands. This can expose a Conversions API key in chat, command arguments, or tool traces, despite the reference telling users not to paste keys into chat.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The exception explicitly permits asking for the key and passing it to a command. It supplies no secret input method that avoids chat or traces.

semantic_findings.title: Browser Handoff Does Not Validate Destinations
semantic_findings.description: The skill tells users to open a URL supplied by setup state without checking its destination. A tampered response could redirect the merchant to a page that imitates an authenticated setup screen.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The instruction relies on the returned URL and gives no host check. No evidence shows that any current response contains a malicious URL.

semantic_findings.title: Profit Setup Enables Broader Data Delivery
semantic_findings.description: Connecting the destination leaves event delivery on by default. The connection can send more than profit, including cart events and shopper identifiers, without a required merchant review of the full data scope.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The guide documents broader payloads and shopper consent checks. It does not require the merchant to review the data scope before enabling delivery.

content.user_title: Set Up Magento Profit Bidding in ChatGPT Ads
content.value_statement: A Magento campaign can meet its revenue target and still lose money. Use Product Metrics to verify profit conversions and use them in ChatGPT Ads.
actual_capabilities: Check Magento and ChatGPT Ads setup status through the Product Metrics CLI or MCP connector.
Guide the merchant through linking a Magento store view and verifying server-side conversion delivery.
Identify consent and cost settings needed to send a profit event for a test order.
Explain how to choose the profit or revenue conversion in ChatGPT Ads Manager.
Suggest an initial target from current profit on ad spend and explain how to verify delivery.
limitations: The guide lists a Product Metrics Pro property and appropriate store, workspace, and Ads Manager access as prerequisites.
A developer installs the Magento module and configures cron. The advertiser selects the campaign conversion in Ads Manager.
Profit events require complete costs and applicable consent. Later refunds do not update events already sent.
The workflow covers Magento profit and revenue bidding, not new-customer, returning-customer, or lifetime-value bidding.

use_cases.title: Check readiness for profit bidding
use_cases.description: Find out whether your store view is connected and which consent, cost, or tracking steps remain.

use_cases.title: Pilot profit bidding on one campaign
use_cases.description: Compare the current revenue target with a starting target based on profit and verify the conversion before switching.

use_cases.title: Diagnose missing profit events
use_cases.description: Use a test order to check store-view mapping, scheduled processing, consent, and cost completeness.

prompt_templates.title: Explain POAS and ROAS
prompt_templates.prompt: Explain profit and revenue bidding for my Magento store. List what I need before I can use profit in ChatGPT Ads.

prompt_templates.title: Review tracking readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Check setup status for [property] and [store view] without changing settings. List which steps are complete and which need action.

prompt_templates.title: Investigate a missing profit event
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: a test order appears with revenue only.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me diagnose test order [order ID] for [store view]. Check consent, scheduled processing, and costs without listing other orders or showing customer details.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a one-campaign switch
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: move an existing campaign from revenue to profit.
prompt_templates.prompt: My current POAS is [ratio]. Propose a starting percentage and a test-order checklist for one campaign. Leave Ads Manager changes for me to approve and make.

output_examples.input: Why did my test order show revenue but no profit?
output: Start with the test order in the linked store view.
Check whether all costs are known and whether the test shopper granted marketing and analytics consent.
After correcting a setting, place another test order and check delivery before changing the campaign conversion.

output_examples.input: What target should I start with if my current POAS is 1.5?
output: Use 150% as a starting target for one campaign once the profit conversion is verified.
That target represents 1.50 in reported profit before ad spend for every 1 spent on ads.
Choose the profit conversion yourself in Ads Manager and review the results after a few weeks.

best_practices: Use a test order with valid consent and known costs before switching the campaign conversion.
Enter the Conversions API key in the authenticated Product Metrics form, not in chat or command arguments.
Start with one campaign and verify the profit conversion and delivery counts before expanding.
anti_patterns: Reuse a revenue-based target after switching the campaign to profit.
Treat an accepted connection test as proof that a real profit event reached Ads Manager.
Enable event delivery without reviewing the event types, customer fields, and consent settings.

faq.question: What is the difference between POAS and ROAS?
faq.answer: POAS divides profit before ad spend by ad spend. ROAS divides revenue by ad spend.

faq.question: Which Magento versions does the guide cover?
faq.answer: It covers Magento 2.4, Magento 2.0, and Magento 1.9 or OpenMage. A developer installs the matching module.

faq.question: Can the assistant change my campaign conversion?
faq.answer: No. You select the conversion in Ads Manager. The assistant can explain the steps and help verify delivery.

faq.question: Why would an order have revenue but no profit event?
faq.answer: An unknown cost can leave an order with revenue only. The profit event also requires marketing and analytics consent.

faq.question: Will existing orders or later refunds update my ads data?
faq.answer: Historical orders are not imported. Later refunds do not revise events that ChatGPT Ads already received.

faq.question: Where should I enter the Conversions API key?
faq.answer: Enter it in the authenticated Product Metrics connection form for the matching Pixel ID. Keep the key out of chat.
